title: Ted Owens, 'Mr PK', claimed to be a biological sensor of UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ted Owens, 'Mr PK', claimed to be a biological sensor of UFOs, about 20th century at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he wrote about a guy named Mr PK tetto and tedo and claimed to be a almost a biological censor of UFOs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove wrote about an American man named Ted Owens, nicknamed Mr PK, for psychokinesis, the supposed power to move things with the mind. According to Michels, Owens claimed to be almost a living sensor for UFOs, that is, unidentified flying objects, which would mean a human body can pick up these craft.
